<thought>The monoisotopic peak at m/z 127.0997 is the [M+H]⁺ ion, giving a neutral mass of ≈126.0997 Da. Matching this mass to plausible formulas, C₈H₁₄O (exact mass 126.1045 Da) is the closest fit and consistent with the observed isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1 from ~8 carbons). No other common heteroatoms improve the fit. Therefore the molecular formula is C8H14O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
